response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced senior individual contributor (~18 years) with genuine developer-tooling contributions (test runners, assertion libraries, CI/dev-ops infrastructure, MCP code generators) and some mobile experience. However, the role is fundamentally a people-management position requiring 2+ years of formal people management and 3+ years of technical leadership, and the resume shows no evidence of managing engineers, running one-on-ones, setting team performance expectations, or leading organizational change. Founder and workshop-teaching experience partially signals leadership, but not the level of management responsibility this Level II Manager role demands.
strengths: 18+ years of software development, well above the 8-year minimum
Authentic developer-tools background: test frameworks (Trial, Fluent-Asserts), CI/CD infrastructure, Selenium training, MCP tooling
Broad technical range including some mobile (iOS/Apple TV) and high-scale systems experience
concerns: No formal people-management experience or direct reports mentioned anywhere
No demonstrated strategic roadmap ownership or organizational-change leadership
Mobile-platform experience is limited and dated (2015–2016), while the role centers on a major mobile ecosystem

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure background
Depth and breadth of engineering experience
